runtime.command_template: python -B tools/run_pinmame_harness.py --library <pinned-pinmame64.dll> --game <set> --rom-path <vpinmame-roms> --work-dir <state-directory> --scenario tools/harness-scenarios/gts3/stargate-<name>.json --dmd-dir <frames> --output <external-run.json>. Each set's nvram-init run starts from an empty state directory (state-init-<set>) and loads factory settings; every other run of that set starts from a new state directory (states/<set>-<name>) holding only that run's NVRAM. Every scenario sets switch_converter gts3, so the harness checks PINMAME_HARDWARE_GEN_GTS3 before touching a switch.

aux-drivers.limitation: A pulsed address is ROM activity, not proof that a load is fitted.
aux-drivers.note: The right flipper steps the displayed DRIVER number and the credit button fires it; the lamp that rose on each press is the displayed number plus 120. Driver = public lamp: name: 0 = 120: REBELLION -#67; 1 = 121: TOP LEFT -#67; 2 = 122: LEFT STARGATE -#67; 3 = 123: RIGHT STARGATE -#67; 4 = 124: TOP RIGHT -#67; 5 = 125: BOTTOM RIGHT -#67; 6 = 126: RA'S EYES -#67 (LB); 7 = 127: WHITE RAILS -#67 (LB).

comparison.note: Every lamp, solenoid, aux driver and switch name this set's tests display is identical to stargat5's at the same address.

nvram-init.limitation: The host answers the ROM with fixed, scripted switch changes; it never moves a ball or a mechanism, so a pulse the ROM fires proves only that the address changed under these conditions.
nvram-init.note: The power-up frame (pixel SHA-256 ec3984b10743e337400fb4528e6314bf232aa68a5b68d32387ac935ae1e6a22a) reads STARGATE / (Install 4 Balls) / Game #742/2, ID #000000, in a font the glyph table does not cover. Displays after each step: "<L FLIPPER TO STEP / R FLIPPER TO SELECT>"; "BOOKKEEPING"; "BOOKKEEPING / GAME ADJUSTMENTS / SELF-TEST / UTILITIES"; "SELF-TEST / UTILITIES"; "UTILITIES"; "CREDIT BUTTON LOADS / ENGLISH / PUSH RIGHT FLIPPER / TO CHANGE LANGUAGE"; "GAME ADJUSTMENTS 1 / FIRST REPLAY LEVEL"; "GAME ADJUSTMENTS 1 / FIRST REPLAY LEVEL".

source.attribution: Generated locally from pinned PinMAME and the user-authorized ROM corpus; ROM bytes, NVRAM and DMD frames remain external.
source.manifest_algorithm: source.sha256 is SHA-256 of manifest.json's exact bytes. manifest.json is compact canonical JSON with sorted keys, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, plus one LF, of {files: [{path, sha256, size}], format: 'pinmame-external-evidence-manifest', game, version: 1}; files lists every file under source.path recursively (the raw run JSON and log of every run, every saved DMD frame, and every state-directory file including the inherited and written NVRAM) except manifest.json and manifest.sha256, sorted by POSIX relative path. tools/build_external_evidence_manifest.py writes and re-checks it.
